description: Change the anchored object options (Optionen für verankertes Objekt) of an object that is already anchored in text – without releasing and re-anchoring it: position inline, above_line or custom (without it the current position stays), and the options of that position as in anchor_frame_in_text – custom: offset_mm {x, y} (only the given coordinate changes), anchor_point, horizontal_reference, vertical_reference, horizontal_alignment, vertical_alignment, keep_within_frame, lock_position; above_line: horizontal_alignment (e.g. center for a chapter vignette), space_before_mm, space_after_mm. Options that do not apply to the position are ignored with a warning; what is omitted stays. invalid_state with details.code "not_anchored" for an object that is not anchored. Returns frame_id, story_id, index, applied[], settings read back, previous_position, bounds_mm, page_id/page_name and story_overset.

anchor_point.description: custom only: reference point on the object.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

horizontal_alignment.description: custom and above_line (above_line: alignment in the text column).

keep_within_frame.description: custom only: keep the object within the top and bottom of the text frame.

offset_mm.description: custom only: offset in mm (x right, y down); only the given coordinate changes.

position.description: New position; without it the current one stays.

space_after_mm.description: above_line only: space after the object (Abstand danach) in mm.

space_before_mm.description: above_line only: space before the object (Abstand davor) in mm.

name: set_anchored_object_options
title: Change anchored object options
